Name: Pie Menu
Author: MasterRoshiHEHE
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#ff9900]Pie Menu[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][i][size=3]A Sims-inspired action wheel for Stardew Valley.[/size][/i][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Hehehe... greetings, young farmers! Master Roshi here, bringing you the latest and greatest vibecod-schlop to make your daily chores a breeze! [/center]

Have you ever wanted to command your farm with the flick of a wrist, just like those folks in The Sims? 
With the Pie Menu, you open a wheel on whatever is under your cursor: a tile, a villager, a monster, or even your own farmer.
Pick what to do, and your farmer will walk right over and do it with the proper tool.  

[size=4][b][color=#ff9900]What it does[/color][/b][/size]
• [b]A wheel for everything:[/b] Talk, give, use, shop, plant, chop, mine, and everything else you normally do by hand.
• [b]Action Queue:[/b] Your picked actions wait their turn in a row of pictures. Click one to take it out of the queue if you change your mind.
• [b]Combat from the wheel:[/b] Attack, use a special attack, pick a weapon, or place bombs. Nothing fights on its own, so you still have to stay sharp!
• [b]Movable Camera:[/b] Look around the map without moving your tired feet.
• [b]The Head in the Middle:[/b] Your farmer's face sits in the middle of the wheel. It looks at what you point at, yawns, and falls asleep if you get too boring and leave it waiting.
• [b]Wardrobe:[/b] Put on and take off your hats, clothes, boots, and rings straight from the wheel.  

[size=4][b][color=#ff9900]Built-in Mod Support[/color][/b][/size]
I have added native wheel options for a few popular mods that graciously have open permissions. Currently, this includes built-in support for: 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5527]Running Key[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46880]Door Knock[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46676]Close Doors[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46789]Door Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone (Continued)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7409]To-Dew[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46966]Quest Journal[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51918]Pixel Waifu Reminiscens[/url]

[size=4][b][color=#ff9900]Default Settings[/color][/b][/size]
I have set up the default settings to mimic The Sims 1, but the GMCM is full of feature toggles and optional hotkeys, so go set it up in a way that fits your playstyle!

[size=4][b][color=#ff9900]Framework & Suggestions[/color][/b][/size]
I want to make this as versatile a framework as possible. I am very open to suggestions for the mod and hope to implement a lot more mod support. Other mod authors can easily put their own mods on the wheel using a Content Patcher data asset or the C# API.  

[size=4][b][color=#ff9900]Documentation[/color][/b][/size]
I have attached a full [b]User Guide[/b] and a [b]Mod Author Guide[/b] in the Articles tab for further instructions. Read them before you come asking questions!


[center][size=4][color=#ff0000][b]EXPECT BUGS[/b][/color][/size][/center]
[center][color=#ff0000]I expect there to be issues. If you run into problems or things break, PLEASE use the bug report function on Nexus.[/color][/center]

[center]The mod currently is delivered as is and I have tested and corrected a lot of issues, however not everything has been fully fool proof tested. I am especially looking for some feedback on the Female Farmers Pie Menu head, as I have mainly worked with the Male farmer while making the mod and mirrored the female farmers settings. 
[/center]
